description: Read one public SEO reference by the id returned from search: an AI crawler record, an active audit rule's public summary and official source, or a public radar update. Returns the text we publish for that reference, its canonical URL and metadata for citation. Read-only; no external network request. Only ids returned by search are accepted; arbitrary URLs are rejected.

id.description: Reference id from search, e.g. crawler:gptbot, rule:<id> or radar:<slug>

name: fetch
title: Fetch a public SEO reference
